name: Masaki (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Masaki town emblem in white: a stylised character of horizontal strokes with a ring.
history: Municipal flag of Masaki, a town in Ehime Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 31 March 1990.

features.role: Masaki town emblem — a stylised character of horizontal strokes with a ring
